## About

Karthik Tatineni is an Independent Software & AI Developer and Electronics & Communication Engineering student at IARE, Hyderabad. He specializes in engineering end-to-end Machine Learning pipelines, Generative AI & agentic platforms, and high-performance full-stack web applications. His work centers on production ML systems (causal feature engineering, entity graphs, real-time risk scoring), local-first Generative AI assistants (open-source LLMs, RAG, ChromaDB), and computer vision pipelines (YOLO, CNNs).

## Key Projects

- FraudGuard: Real-time anti-fraud engine (XGBoost, FastAPI, Redis, Optuna, MLflow) — 0.941 ROC-AUC, 93.8% recall, <15ms latency
- Aegis AI: Local-first AI assistant platform with RAG, ChromaDB, and open-source LLMs (Mistral 7B, Qwen 2.5) on Lightning AI GPU
- Real-Time Helmet & Triple-Ride Detection: Multi-class deep learning CV pipeline (YOLO, CNN, TensorFlow, OpenCV)
- DeepSeek Coder Fine-Tuning: QLoRA cloud-based fine-tuning pipeline for coding LLMs on NVIDIA GPUs
- KLVORA Fashion Hub: Production Next.js e-commerce platform with Supabase, AI support, Three.js, and Google SEO
- Touchwood Interiors CMS: Production Next.js CMS with Sanity, Supabase, AI chatbot, and interactive 3D visualization
